units.literal: In punishing guilt no offender is too small to be spared—or so the statutes say; to comfort the wronged and raise humanity runs to the heart of sage governance.

units.zh: 宜從蕩宥，許以自新，可一同放遣，還復民籍。
units.en: Let a broad amnesty allow them to begin anew: release them all at once and restore them to the civilian registers.
units.literal: Let general pardon be granted and self-renewal allowed; they may all be released together and restored to civilian registers.

units.zh: 已賞賜者，亦皆爲贖。」
units.en: Those who have already been given bounty may also buy their way back to freedom."
units.literal: Those already rewarded with gifts shall also be redeemed."

units.zh: 辛丑，詔曰：「往歲蠻虜協謀，志擾邊服，羣帥授略，大殲凶醜。
units.en: Day xinchou: an edict said: "Last year the southern tribes conspired and meant to harry the frontier; our generals took their measures and crushed the foe.
units.literal: Day xinchou: An edict said: "Last year the southern barbarians plotted together, intending to trouble the border; commanders were given strategy and the vicious enemy was greatly destroyed.

units.zh: 革城克捷，及舞陰固守，二處勞人，未有沾爵賞者，可分遣選部，往彼序用。」
units.en: Gecheng fell quickly and Wuyin held firm—two places whose soldiers toiled yet have not received rank or bounty. Send selection officers to list merits and appoint rewards on the spot."
units.literal: At Gecheng victory was swift, and at Wuyin's stubborn defense—two places whose men labored yet have not tasted rank or reward—selection officers may be sent to record merits and appoint them there."

units.zh: 九月癸丑，詔「東西二省府國，長老所積，財單祿寡，良以矜懷。
units.en: Ninth month, day guichou: an edict ran: "In the eastern and western secretariats, palace offices, and princely households, men who have served long yet are poor in goods and thin in salary stir our pity.
units.literal: Ninth month, day guichou: An edict: "In the eastern and western two provinces, palace bureaus, and princely establishments, those who have labored long but whose wealth is thin and stipends few move us deeply to compassion.

units.zh: 選部可甄才品能，推校年月，邦守邑丞，隨宜量處，以貧爲先。」
units.en: Let the selection bureau weigh talent and rank, check years of service, and let prefects and magistrates place men as fits—always putting the needy first."
units.literal: The Selection Bureau may sift talent and capacity, weigh years of service, and district heads and magistrates may dispose as fit, with poverty foremost."

units.zh: 詔曰：「執耜蹔忘，懸磬比室，秉機或惰，無褐終年。
units.en: An edict said: "To leave the hoe even for a moment is to leave every house with an empty larder; to let the loom stand idle is to face a year without cloth—
units.literal: An edict said: "To lay aside the plough even briefly, to hang the harp as if the house were empty; to let the loom idle, to go without cloth all year—

units.zh: 非怠非荒，雖由王道，不稂不莠，實賴民和。
units.en: neither neglect nor excess is the whole of kingship, but neither tares nor blight can be cleared without the people's accord.
units.literal: neither slackness nor dissipation alone makes good rule, yet neither weeds nor blighted grain can be checked without the people's harmony.

units.zh: 頃歲多稼無爽，遺秉如積，而三登之美未臻，萬斯之基尚遠。
units.en: Lately the seasons have brought rich harvests and leftover sheaves have heaped the fields, yet the thrice-abundant age has not come and the base for ten thousand generations is still distant.
units.literal: In recent years harvests have been many and timely, and grain left in the fields piled up like chaff, yet the triple abundance has not been achieved and the foundation of ten thousand years still lies far off.

units.zh: 且風土異宜，百民殊務，刑章治緒，未必同源。
units.en: Soil and custom suit different crops, and the hundred clans have different trades; law and administration need not all follow one mold.
units.literal: Soils and customs differ in fitness, and the hundred clans have different tasks; penal codes and governing threads need not all spring from one source.

units.zh: 妨本害政，事非一揆，冕旒屬念，無忘夙興。
units.en: What undermines the root and harms rule takes more than one form; the throne keeps it in mind and will not forget to rise at dawn.
units.literal: What harms the root and injures government is not of one kind alone; the imperial mind is fixed upon it and will not forget early rising.

units.zh: 可嚴下州郡，務滋耕殖，相畝辟疇，廣開地利，深樹國本，克阜民天。
units.en: Charge the provinces and commanderies strictly to foster planting, open fields plot by plot, widen the land's yield, and deepen the state's root so the people's livelihood may flourish.
units.literal: Let the prefectures and commanderies be strictly charged to promote tillage, open fields acre by acre, widen the land's profit, and deepen the state's foundation so the people's heaven may be enriched.

units.zh: 又詢訪獄市，博聽謠俗，傷風損化，各以條聞，主者詳爲條格。」
units.en: Examine prisons and markets, listen widely to street rumor, and report whatever harms custom or mars reform in separate memorials, for the chief office to draft detailed rules."
units.literal: Inquire also into prisons and markets, listen widely to popular songs, and report whatever wounds custom or mars transformation, each in its own entry, for the responsible office to draft detailed statutes."

units.zh: 今日見作天王，便是大罪，左右主帥，動見拘執，不如作市邊屠酤富兒百倍矣。」
units.en: Now they have made me a king—that is the great sin; the stewards on every side bind me; I would rather be a rich butcher or tavern-keeper by the market a hundred times over."
units.literal: Today I am made a king—that is a great crime; the stewards left and right seize me at every turn; better to be a rich butcher or wine-seller by the market a hundred times over."

units.zh: 每見錢，輒曰：「我昔時思汝一文不得，今得用汝未？」
units.en: Whenever he saw cash he would say: "Once I longed for you and could not get a single coin—may I spend you now?"
units.literal: Whenever he saw money he would say: "In old days I longed for you and could not get a single cash—may I use you now?"

units.zh: 朞年之間，世祖齋庫儲錢數億垂盡。
units.en: Within a year the several hundred million in Emperor Wu's fasting treasury and stored coin was nearly spent.
units.literal: Within a year Emperor Wu's fasting treasury and stored coin, several hundred million, was nearly exhausted.

units.zh: 毀世祖招婉殿，乞閹人徐龍駒爲齋。
units.en: He tore down Emperor Wu's Zhaowan Hall and asked the eunuch Xu Longju to keep a fast for him.
units.literal: He destroyed Emperor Wu's Zhaowan Hall and begged the eunuch Xu Longju for a fast.

units.zh: 南齊書卷第四 本紀第四
units.en: Book of Southern Qi, Volume 4, Annals 4
units.literal: Book of Southern Qi, Volume 4, Annals 4

units.zh: 五月己巳，以征虜將軍蕭懿爲益州刺史，前軍將軍陰廣宗爲梁、南秦二州刺史，前新除寧州刺史李慶宗爲寧州刺史。
units.en: Fifth month, day jisi: Xiao Yi, suppressing-the-barbarians general, was made inspector of Yi; Yin Guangzong, vanguard general, was made inspector of Liang and South Qin; Li Qingzong, previously newly appointed inspector of Ning, was again made inspector of Ning.
units.literal: Fifth month, day jisi: Suppressing-the-Barbarians General Xiao Yi was made Inspector of Yi; Vanguard General Yin Guangzong was made Inspector of Liang and South Qin; Li Qingzong, previously newly appointed as Inspector of Ning, was again made Inspector of Ning.

units.zh: 江謐 荀伯玉
units.en: Jiang Mi; Xun Boyu
units.literal: Jiang Mi; Xun Boyu

units.zh: 荀伯玉字弄璋，廣陵人也。
units.en: Xun Boyu, styled Nongzhang, came from Guangling.
units.literal: Xun Boyu, styled Nongzhang, was a native of Guangling.

units.zh: 建元元年，封南豐縣子，四百戶。
units.en: In Jianyuan's first year he was enfeoffed Viscount of Nanfeng, with four hundred households.
units.literal: In the first year of Jianyuan he was enfeoffed as Viscount of Nanfeng, with a fief of four hundred households.

units.zh: 泰始初，子勛舉事，伯玉友人孫沖爲將帥，伯玉隷其驅使，封新亭侯。
units.en: When Taishi opened, Zixun rose in rebellion; Boyu's friend Sun Chong took command, and Boyu rode under him and was enfeoffed Marquis of Xinting.
units.literal: At the opening of Taishi, Zixun raised arms; Boyu's friend Sun Chong became a commander, and Boyu followed his orders and was enfeoffed Marquis of Xinting.

units.zh: 太祖鎮淮陰，伯玉歸身結事，爲太祖冠軍刑獄參軍。
units.en: While the founding emperor was posted at Huaiyin, Boyu threw himself on his service and became adjutant for prisons under the champion army.
units.literal: When the founding emperor held Huaiyin, Boyu pledged himself and served him, and was made the founding emperor's Champion Army adjutant for prisons and punishment.

units.zh: 昇明初，仍爲太祖驃騎中兵參軍，除步兵校尉，不拜。
units.en: When Shengming opened he again held central-troop aide in the Grand Ancestor's marshal staff; Colonel of the Footsoldiers was offered, and he declined.
units.literal: At the opening of Shengming he again served the Grand Ancestor as central-troop aide in the Marshal's headquarters; he was named Colonel of the Footsoldiers but did not accept.

units.zh: 伯玉少爲柳元景撫軍板行參軍，南徐州祭酒，晉安王子勛鎮軍行參軍。
units.en: Young, Boyu served as acting adjutant on Liu Yuanjing's pacifier-army staff, as libationer of southern Xuzhou, and as acting adjutant on the stabilizing army of Prince Zixun of Jin'an.
units.literal: In youth Boyu was acting adjutant on Liu Yuanjing's Pacifier Army staff, libationer of South Xuzhou, and acting adjutant on Prince Zixun of Jin'an's Stabilizing Army.

units.zh: 加前軍將軍。
units.en: He was raised to Front Army General.
units.literal: He was advanced to Front Army General.

units.zh: 事敗，伯玉還都賣卜自業。
units.en: When the cause collapsed, Boyu went back to the capital and made his living casting lots.
units.literal: When the affair failed, Boyu returned to the capital and sold divination for a living.

units.zh: 伯玉勸太祖遣數十騎入虜界，安置標榜，於是虜游騎數百履行界上，太祖以聞，猶懼不得留，令伯玉卜，伯玉斷卦不成行，而明帝詔果復太祖本任，由是見親待。
units.en: Boyu urged him to send a few dozen riders into the northern marches and set up boundary markers; soon hundreds of enemy patrols were riding the line. The founding emperor reported it, yet still feared the court would recall him and had Boyu cast the hexagrams; Boyu read that the journey would not succeed, and Emperor Ming's edict in fact restored him to his old command. From that day he was held close.
units.literal: Boyu urged the founding emperor to send several dozen horsemen into the enemy frontier to set up markers; thereupon several hundred enemy patrol horsemen rode the border. The founding emperor reported it, yet still feared he could not remain; he had Boyu divine, and Boyu read the hexagram as unfit to travel; Emperor Ming's edict indeed restored the founding emperor to his former post, and from this he was treated with intimacy.

units.zh: 令伯玉看宅，知家事。
units.en: The founding emperor set him to watch the mansion and run the household.
units.literal: The founding emperor had Boyu watch the residence and manage household affairs.

units.zh: 上嘉伯玉盡心，愈見親信，軍國密事，多委使之。
units.en: The throne prized Boyu's wholehearted service and drew him closer still; military and state secrets went largely through his hands.
units.literal: The throne praised Boyu's wholehearted service and trusted him all the more; military and state secrets were largely entrusted to him.

units.zh: 建平王景素聞而招之，伯玉不往。
units.en: Prince Jingsu of Jianping heard of him and called him in; Boyu would not go.
units.literal: Prince Jingsu of Jianping heard and recruited him; Boyu did not go.

units.zh: 初，太祖在淮南，伯玉假還廣陵，夢上廣陵城南樓上，有二青衣小兒語伯玉云：「草中肅，九五相追逐。」
units.en: Early on, while the founding emperor was in Huainan, Boyu went home on leave to Guangling and dreamed he stood on the city's south tower; two boys in blue called to him, "Amid the grass, su—nine-fives in pursuit."
units.literal: At first, while the founding emperor was in Huainan, Boyu took leave to Guangling and dreamed that he was on the south tower of Guangling city; two boys in blue said to Boyu: "Su in the grass; nine-fives pursue each other."

units.zh: 泰始七年，伯玉又夢太祖乘船在廣陵北渚，見上兩掖下有翅不舒。
units.en: In Taishi year seven he dreamed again that the founding emperor sailed a boat at Guangling's north ford, wings folded under both arms.
units.literal: In the seventh year of Taishi Boyu again dreamed that the founding emperor was in a boat at the north ford of Guangling and that under both armpits were wings not yet spread.

units.zh: 伯玉問何當舒，上曰：「却後三年。」
units.en: Boyu asked when they would open; the emperor said, "Three years hence."
units.literal: Boyu asked when they would spread; the emperor said: "Three years from now."

units.zh: 伯玉夢中自謂是呪師，向上唾呪之，凡六呪，有六龍出，兩掖下翅皆舒，還而復斂。
units.en: In the dream Boyu thought himself a curse-master, spat six curses upward, six dragons rose, the wings under both arms opened, then folded shut again.
units.literal: In the dream Boyu took himself for a curse-master, spat curses upward six times, six dragons emerged, the wings under both armpits spread and then closed again.

units.zh: 伯玉謂親人曰：「太子所爲，官終不知，豈得顧死蔽官耳目。
units.en: Boyu told his family: "The crown prince is doing what the throne will never hear of in the end—who dies to blind the court to it?
units.literal: Boyu told his kin: "What the crown prince is doing, the throne will never know of in the end—how can one choose death to cover the throne's eyes and ears?

units.zh: 我不啓聞，誰應啓者？」
units.en: If I do not speak, who will?"
units.literal: If I do not report it, who should?"

units.zh: 伯玉後聞之，曰：「朝聞道，夕死可矣。」
units.en: When Boyu heard it later he said: "Hear the Way at dawn, and dusk is time enough to die."
units.literal: When Boyu later heard of it he said: "If one has heard the Way at dawn, one may die at dusk."

units.zh: 因世祖拜陵後密啓之。
units.en: So after Shizu came back from the tombs he sent a secret memorial.
units.literal: Accordingly, after Shizu returned from the tombs he secretly memorialized the throne.

units.zh: 時人爲之語曰：「十敕五令，不如荀伯玉命。」
units.en: A saying ran: "Ten throne edicts and five orders weigh less than one word from Xun Boyu."
units.literal: Men of the time made a saying of it: "Ten imperial edicts and five orders are not as good as one command from Xun Boyu."

units.zh: 永明元年，垣崇祖誅，伯玉并伏法。
units.en: In Yongming's first year Yuan Chongzu was killed, and Boyu died by the same sentence.
units.literal: In the first year of Yongming, Yuan Chongzu was executed, and Boyu was put to death with him.

units.zh: 死時年五十。
units.en: He was fifty at his death.
units.literal: At his death he was fifty.

units.zh: 伯玉憂懼無計，上聞之，以其與垣崇祖善，慮相扇爲亂，加意撫之，伯玉乃安。
units.en: Boyu was trapped in fear. The throne heard of it; knowing his tie to Yuan Chongzu, he feared the two would rouse each other to revolt and soothed him with special care—only then did Boyu grow calm.
units.literal: Boyu was anxious and at his wits' end; when the throne heard of it, because he was close to Yuan Chongzu he feared they would stir each other to revolt and treated him with added care—only then did Boyu settle.

units.zh: 察江、荀之行也，雖異術而同亡。
units.en: Weigh Jiang's path and Xun's: different arts, the same fall.
units.literal: When one weighs Jiang's conduct and Xun's, the methods differed yet both perished.

units.zh: 贊曰：謐口禍門，荀言亟盡。
units.en: The encomium runs: Mi's mouth opened the gate of ruin; Xun's counsel ran out too soon.
units.literal: The encomium says: Mi's mouth was the gate of disaster; Xun's words were soon spent.

units.zh: 元徽二年，而太祖破桂陽，威名大震。
units.en: In Yuanhui year two the founding emperor broke Guiyang, and his name thundered across the realm.
units.literal: In the second year of Yuanhui the founding emperor crushed Guiyang and his renown shook greatly.

units.zh: 霸業旣建，伯玉忠勤盡心，常衞左右。
units.en: When the founding cause was won, Boyu gave himself over in loyal, tireless service and never left the Grand Ancestor's side.
units.literal: Once the founding enterprise was secure, Boyu served with loyal, tireless devotion and constantly guarded the Grand Ancestor's person.

units.zh: 烏奴率亡命千餘人攻梁州，爲刺史王玄邈所破，復走還氐中。
units.en: Wunu led more than a thousand desperate men against Liangzhou, was defeated by Inspector Wang Xuanmiao, and fled back to the Di lands.
units.literal: Wunu led more than a thousand desperate men to attack Liangzhou, was broken by the Inspector Wang Xuanyao, and again fled back among the Di.

units.zh: 荊州刺史豫章王嶷遣兵討烏奴，檄梁州能斬送烏奴首，賞本郡，烏奴田宅事業悉賜之。
units.en: Xiao Yi, Prince of Yuzhang and inspector of Jingzhou, sent troops against Wunu and proclaimed that whoever in Liangzhou could deliver Wunu's head would receive his native commandery and all his lands and property.
units.literal: The Inspector of Jingzhou the Prince of Yuzhang Xiao Yi sent troops to punish Wunu, proclaiming that Liangzhou, if able to behead and deliver Wunu's head, would be rewarded with its native commandery and all of Wunu's fields, houses, and enterprises would be granted.

units.zh: 君弈世忠款，深識理順，想卽起義，應接大軍，共爲掎角，討滅烏奴，剋建忠勤，茂立誠節。
units.en: You have been loyal for generations and understand where duty lies; we expect you to rise at once, join our main army in a pincer movement, destroy Wunu, win merit through loyalty, and stand as a model of integrity.
units.literal: My lord, your house for generations has been loyal and sincere, deeply knowing what reason and compliance require; we expect you at once to rise in righteous action, meet our great army, together form pincers, destroy Wunu, achieve merit in loyalty and diligence, and abundantly establish sincere integrity.
